privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: Owner: accept or reject each proposal; decide the freeze lines for the other repositories
goal: Each proposal accepted or rejected and recorded on F-020 with its date
acceptance: the owner accepts or rejects each T04 proposal and the T01 freeze lines, with plain-language options written beside each (no re-explanation needed); the decision and its date are recorded on F-020
accepted proposals are made by sessions in their own repositories under their rules; nothing is edited in a component from this repository

effort.basis: about 12 yes or no decisions at 2 to 3 minutes each, options pre-written in T04. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed for coordinator-only work. Not a measurement.
